cases.translation: ...and a house where there is strife falls.
cases.explain: Дом is the subject of рушится (falls) — subjects take the nominative.

cases.sentence: Один из ___ попросил Его: «Господи, научи нас молиться».
cases.translation: One of the disciples asked him, "Lord, teach us to pray."
cases.explain: Из (from among) always takes the genitive; учеников is genitive plural — 'one of the disciples'.

cases.sentence: Другие... попросили, чтобы Он показал им знамение с ___.
cases.translation: Others asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
cases.explain: С meaning 'from' takes the genitive → неба, 'a sign from heaven'.

cases.sentence: Даже если он не даст ему по ___, ему все-таки придется помочь.
cases.translation: Even if he won't give it to him out of friendship, he will still have to help.
cases.explain: По in the sense 'out of, by reason of' takes the dative → по дружбе, 'out of friendship'.

cases.sentence: Если я изгоняю ___ силой Вельзевула, то чьей силой изгоняют их ваши последователи?
cases.translation: If I drive out demons by the power of Beelzebul, then by whose power do your followers drive them out?
cases.explain: Демонов is the direct object of the transitive verb изгонять (to cast out) → accusative; for animate nouns the plural accusative equals the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: И прости нам наши ___, ведь и мы прощаем каждому, кто нам должен.
cases.translation: And forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who is indebted to us.
cases.explain: Грехи is the direct object of the transitive verb прости (forgive) → accusative plural, which equals the nominative plural for this inanimate noun.

cases.sentence: Но если я изгоняю демонов ___ Божьим, то это значит, что Царство Божие пришло к вам.
cases.translation: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the Kingdom of God has come to you.
cases.explain: Перстом is an instrumental of means, used without a preposition — 'by/with the finger' of God.

cases.sentence: Некоторые говорили, он изгоняет демонов ___ Вильзевула, повелителя демонов.
cases.translation: Some said, he casts out demons by the power of Beelzebul, the prince of demons.
cases.explain: Силой is another instrumental of means without a preposition — 'by the power' of Beelzebul.

cases.sentence: Горе вам, фарисеи, потому что вы любите... когда вас приветствуют на ___.
cases.translation: Woe to you, Pharisees, because you love... to be greeted in the marketplaces.
cases.explain: На marking a stationary location (no motion) takes the prepositional; площадях is prepositional plural — 'at the marketplaces'.

reading.ru: «Господи, научи нас молиться, как и Иоанн научил своих учеников».
reading.question: What does one of the disciples ask Jesus to teach them?
reading.explain: A disciple asks Jesus, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."

reading.ru: «Друг, одолжи мне три лепешки, ко мне с дороги заехал гость, и мне нечего ему предложить».
reading.question: What does the man ask his friend for at midnight?
reading.explain: He asks, "Friend, lend me three loaves, because a guest has arrived and I have nothing to set before him."

reading.ru: Поэтому я говорю вам, просите, и вам дадут, ищите и найдете, стучите, и вам откроют».
reading.question: According to Jesus, what happens to those who ask, seek, and knock?
options: They receive, find, and have the door opened to them
reading.correct: They receive, find, and have the door opened to them
reading.explain: "Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you."

reading.ru: Если вы, будучи злы, умеете давать своим детям благие дары, то тем более небесный отец даст Святого Духа тем, кто просит у него».
reading.question: What will the heavenly Father give to those who ask him?
reading.explain: "How much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?"

reading.ru: Однажды Иисус изгнал демона немоты, и когда демон вышел, человек, который был нем, заговорил.
reading.question: What happened when Jesus cast out the demon of muteness?
options: The formerly mute man began to speak
reading.correct: The formerly mute man began to speak
reading.explain: When the demon went out, the man who had been mute spoke, and the crowds marveled.

reading.ru: Любое царство, разделившееся на враждующие части, приходит в запустение, и дом, где есть распря, рушится.
reading.question: What does Jesus say happens to a kingdom divided against itself?
reading.explain: "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to ruin, and a house divided falls."

reading.ru: Но если я изгоняю демонов перстом Божьим, то это значит, что Царство Божие пришло к вам».
reading.question: What does Jesus say proves that God's Kingdom has come?
options: Casting out demons by the finger of God
reading.correct: Casting out demons by the finger of God
reading.explain: "If I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the Kingdom of God has come to you."

reading.ru: Но если кто-то более сильный нападет и одолеет его, то он заберет оружие, на которое полагался хозяин, и разделит добычу.
reading.question: What happens when someone stronger attacks the armed man guarding his house?
options: The stronger man takes his armor and divides his plunder
reading.correct: The stronger man takes his armor and divides his plunder
reading.explain: A stronger attacker overcomes him, takes the armor he trusted in, and divides his plunder.

reading.ru: Тогда он идет и берет семь других духов, еще более злых, чем он сам, и они приходят и поселяются там.
reading.question: What does the unclean spirit do after finding its old house swept and put in order?
options: It brings seven other spirits more evil than itself
reading.correct: It brings seven other spirits more evil than itself
reading.explain: The spirit brings seven other spirits more evil than itself, and together they dwell there, making the man's state worse than before.

reading.ru: Иисус ответил, Блаженнее те, кто слышит Слово Божие и исполняет его.
reading.question: How does Jesus respond to the woman who calls his mother blessed?
options: He says blessed are those who hear God's word and keep it
reading.correct: He says blessed are those who hear God's word and keep it
reading.explain: Jesus answers that blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and keep it.

reading.ru: Оно ищет знамение, но ему не будет дано никакого знамения, кроме знамения пророка Ионы».
reading.question: What sign will this generation be given, according to Jesus?
options: The sign of the prophet Jonah
reading.correct: The sign of the prophet Jonah
reading.explain: "No sign will be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah."

reading.ru: Царица Юга встанет в день суда с людьми этого поколения и осудит их.
reading.question: Why will the Queen of the South condemn this generation?
options: Because she came from afar to hear Solomon's wisdom, yet someone greater than Solomon is here
Because she was more righteous than Solomon
Because she refused to listen to Jonah
reading.correct: Because she came from afar to hear Solomon's wisdom, yet someone greater than Solomon is here
reading.explain: She came from the ends of the earth to hear Solomon's wisdom, and one greater than Solomon is here now.

reading.question: What does Jesus compare to the lamp of the body?
reading.explain: "Your eye is the lamp of your body; when your eye is clear, your whole body is full of light."

reading.ru: Фарисея удивило, что он не совершил перед едой ритуального омовения, но Господь сказал ему, Вот вы, фарисеи, очищаете чаши и тарелки снаружи, но внутри вы полны жадности и злобы.
reading.question: What surprised the Pharisee about Jesus at dinner?
options: That Jesus did not perform the ritual washing before the meal
reading.correct: That Jesus did not perform the ritual washing before the meal
reading.explain: The Pharisee was surprised that Jesus had not washed ritually before the meal.

reading.ru: «Горе вам, учители закона, потому что вы присвоили ключ знания, но и сами не вошли, и тем, кто хотел войти, воспрепятствовали».
reading.question: What woe does Jesus pronounce on the experts in the law regarding the 'key of knowledge'?
options: They took away the key of knowledge, neither entering themselves nor letting others in
They lost the scrolls of the Law
They gave away all their knowledge freely
reading.correct: They took away the key of knowledge, neither entering themselves nor letting others in
reading.explain: "You have taken away the key of knowledge; you did not enter in yourselves, and you hindered those who were entering."
